parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs a low-targeting division with a hostile national layer. National binary-sex rules, birth-sex passports/facilities, and entry cable requiring refusal on sex discrepancy and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility create universal document exposure; immigration and prison custody document forced labour, beatings, sexual abuse and hormone removal. Locally, vetoed bathroom bills, Title VII/municipal protections and July 2026 low-risk classification reduce local facility/arrest risk, but state hate-crime omission, panic defence, youth-targeting laws and cancelled Pride leave thin recourse if outed at border, in federal facilities or custody.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary-sex order and passport rule; entry cable: document/record discrepancy casting doubt on sex requires refusal and more evidence, suspected wilful misrepresentation may support permanent lifetime ineligibility.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry for nationals; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers; passport suit pending and some orders enjoined.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch at entry can escalate to refusal, investigation and custody; local low-risk status does not pre-empt federal screening.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody: trans men reported forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse; corrections adopted model cutting hair, removing hormones and conversion-type therapy, stopped reporting trans prisoners.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented for visitors: no documented consular, legal-aid or placement protocol in dossier.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry discrepancy or facility trespass can lead to detention where birth-sex placement and reported abuse increase severity.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity; many divisions ban such use, 4 criminalise in certain circumstances, documented capitol restroom arrest elsewhere and 24h men's-ward holding.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Division governor vetoed bathroom/pronoun bills; July 2026 assessment places division in low-risk group largely refraining from targeting adults; no local ban documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal buildings/facilities remain exposed despite local veto; private settings in 6 divisions also banned, status for this division on private settings not_documented.

care_services.exposure: National orders target minor gender-affirming care; 27 divisions ban children's care; proposed rules would bar public insurance under 18; DOJ subpoenaed hospitals.
care_services.protection: June 2023 order gave state employees over 21 Medicaid gender-affirming coverage; county conversion-therapy ban and funding bar; adult visitor care access not documented.
care_services.interaction: Adult visitor may face federal facility/ward placement by birth sex and medication interruption in custody; minor care seeker faces division surgery ban and school-reporting hotline.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National rhetoric frames 'radical gender ideology'/'radically pro-transgender' actors for counterterrorism prioritisation; January 2025 order directs criminal investigation/prosecution over facilitating minor transition.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: 2020 Title VII ruling, 2023 gubernatorial order and DOJ affirmation include gender identity; municipal ordinances in 9 cities with exemptions; several national orders blocked/enjoined.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat framing raises police/child-welfare scrutiny for travelling families, while patchwork protections depend on administration and city.

minors_guardians.exposure: Division bans sex-reassignment surgery for trans children and bars trans girls from female sports; education hotline reports gender-ideology exposure; national care/teacher investigations.
minors_guardians.protection: 2019 court limited family-court intervention to imminent harm; 2024 order allowed birth-certificate change without surgery after 2020 suit; status after order not documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian travelling with minor risks school, sports, care and disclosure scrutiny distinct from adult; adult low-risk judgement may not extend if priorities shift.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State hate-crime statute excludes gender identity; gay/trans panic defence remains available; Pride in second-largest city cancelled Jan 2026 and organisation dissolved citing political/financial environment.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity since 2009; one in seven to one-fifth of single-bias incidents relate to sexual orientation nationally, not trans-specific rate.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: If assaulted, traveller relies on national statute and uneven municipal protection; no division-specific trans violence incident documented, absence is not safety.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Practical exposure depends on measures in effect at travel; passport, executive-order and health-rule litigation unresolved; 2026 bans expanding, 4 divisions flagged Do Not Travel nationally.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have blocked/enjoined several orders; ACLU passport suit and legal-aid FAQ exist; remedies slow and not shown to prevent entry refusal or custody harm in real time.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Paper litigation does not cancel operative border/facility/custody rules; local low-risk criteria and post-2024 birth-certificate ruling status are uncertain.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar universal stops, humiliating questioning and weak real-time remedy, but here refusal/lifetime-ineligibility risk and documented custody abuse are harsher, while active court injunctions are stronger, placing case near but slightly above this anchor.

Similar discretionary secondary screening, refusal and slow appeal, but national birth-sex facility rule, possible fraud ineligibility and severe custody reports add exposures absent from 0.55-B, so rating is materially lower.

Unlike 0.75-C, documents matching presentation are not accepted nationally, detention is not the worst outcome, and no tribunal remedy is documented for entry refusal; local protections only partially offset, so rating is well below.

parsed.synthesis: Operative interaction is sequential: federal document screening can refuse entry or trigger fraud inquiry, federal facility rules out the traveller in government spaces, and any detention carries documented severe abuse and hormone removal. Division law mitigates by vetoing bathroom bills, municipal protections and low adult targeting, but exemptions, panic defence, missing state hate-crime coverage, youth bans and Pride collapse thin recourse. Minors face added care, school and sports exposures. No execution or routine imprisonment for presence is documented, keeping score above 0.35, yet universal tier-1 exposures keep it below 0.55.
